key_developments: Democrats project strong House gains with 63 races moving toward Democrats versus only 1 toward Republicans in final ratings changes.
Latino voter turnout surge expected as Hispanic voters who sat out 2024 return to polls, potentially boosting Democratic performance.
Senate control remains highly competitive with Democrats needing net +4 seats to gain majority, with 7 toss-up races according to Cook Political Report.
Multiple traditionally Republican strongholds like Kansas, Iowa, and South Carolina are now competitive or toss-up races, showing Trump's drag on GOP performance.
Trump campaign struggles evident through rally cancellations in Kansas and Iowa just 4 days before election, signaling GOP vulnerability in typically safe states.
